  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
  <title>Invest, Finance & Value — GlobalStone</title>
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com" />
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin />
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Playfair+Display:wght@400;600;700&family=Plus+Jakarta+Sans:wght@300;400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet" />
  <style>
    *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
    :root {
      --primary: #003F2D; --primary-dark: #012A2D; --primary-light: #005240;
      --accent: #C9A84C; --accent-hover: #E2C06A;
      --navy: #0A1628; --text-primary: #0A1628; --text-secondary: #4A5568; --text-muted: #718096;
      --border: #E2E8F0; --gray-100: #F7F8FA;
      --font-display: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, serif;
      --font-body: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif;
    }
    html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }
    body { font-family: var(--font-body); color: var(--text-primary); background: #fff; line-height: 1.6; -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; }
    a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; }
    img { max-width: 100%; display: block; }

    /* SHARED HEADER */
    .site-header { position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; z-index: 1000; background: rgba(10,22,40,0.97); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); }
    .header-inner { max-width: 1440px; margin: 0 auto; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 0 40px; height: 70px; }
    .logo { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700; color: #fff; letter-spacing: -0.3px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; }
    .logo-mark { width: 32px; height: 32px; background: var(--accent); clip-path: polygon(50% 0%, 100% 25%, 100% 75%, 50% 100%, 0% 75%, 0% 25%); flex-shrink: 0; }
    .main-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; }
    .nav-item { position: relative; }
    .nav-link { display: block; padding: 8px 14px; font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 500; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.85); cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.2s; white-space: nowrap; }
    .nav-link:hover { color: #fff; }
    .nav-link.has-dropdown::after { content: ''; display: inline-block; width: 6px; height: 6px; border-right: 1.5px solid currentColor; border-bottom: 1.5px solid currentColor; transform: rotate(45deg) translateY(-2px); margin-left: 6px; vertical-align: middle; transition: transform 0.2s; }
    .nav-item:hover .nav-link.has-dropdown::after, .nav-item.open .nav-link.has-dropdown::after { transform: rotate(-135deg) translateY(-2px); }
    .mega-menu { position: absolute; top: calc(100% + 1px); left: 50%; width: 640px; background: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: 0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.15); padding: 28px 32px; opacity: 0; visibility: hidden; pointer-events: none; transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(-8px); transition: opacity 0.22s, transform 0.22s, visibility 0.22s; }
    .nav-item:hover .mega-menu, .nav-item.open .mega-menu { opacity: 1; visibility: visible; pointer-events: auto; transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(0); }
    .mega-menu-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 32px; }
    .mega-col-title { font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 1.5px; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text-muted); margin-bottom: 14px; padding-bottom: 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); }
    .mega-link { display: block; padding: 7px 0; font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--text-primary); transition: color 0.15s, padding-left 0.15s; }
    .mega-link:hover { color: var(--primary); padding-left: 6px; }
    .mega-link-badge { display: inline-block; font-size: 10px; padding: 1px 6px; background: var(--gray-100); color: var(--text-muted); border-radius: 20px; margin-left: 8px; vertical-align: middle; }
    .header-actions { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; }
    .btn-contact { padding: 8px 20px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; background: var(--accent); color: var(--navy); border-radius: 4px; transition: background 0.2s; }
    .btn-contact:hover { background: var(--accent-hover); }
    .mobile-toggle { display: none; flex-direction: column; gap: 5px; background: none; border: none; cursor: pointer; padding: 6px; }
    .mobile-toggle span { display: block; width: 24px; height: 2px; background: #fff; }
    .mobile-drawer { display: none; position: fixed; top: 70px; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; background: var(--navy); overflow-y: auto; z-index: 999; padding: 20px 24px 40px; transform: translateX(100%); transition: transform 0.3s ease; }
    .mobile-drawer.open { transform: translateX(0); }
    .mobile-nav-link { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 14px 0; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 500; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.9); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); }
    .mobile-accordion { overflow: hidden; max-height: 0; transition: max-height 0.3s ease; }
    .mobile-accordion.open { max-height: 400px; }
    .mobile-accordion-item { display: block; padding: 10px 16px; font-size: 14px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06); }
    .mobile-accordion-title { font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 1.2px; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--accent); padding: 12px 16px 4px; }

    /* BREADCRUMB */
    .breadcrumb { background: var(--gray-100); padding: 78px 40px 16px; }
    .breadcrumb-inner { max-width: 1440px; margin: 0 auto; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-muted); }
    .breadcrumb a { color: var(--text-muted); transition: color 0.15s; }
    .breadcrumb a:hover { color: var(--primary); }
    .breadcrumb-sep { opacity: 0.5; }
    .breadcrumb-current { color: var(--text-primary); font-weight: 500; }

    /* PAGE HERO */
    .page-hero { background: var(--navy); padding: 48px 40px 80px; position: relative; overflow: hidden; }
    .page-hero-bg { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0A1628 0%, #003F2D 60%, #012A2D 100%); }
    .page-hero-image { position: absolute; right: 0; top: 0; bottom: 0; width: 45%; background: url('https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1611974789855-9c2a0a7236a3?w=900&q=80') center/cover; opacity: 0.25; }
    .page-hero-overlay { position: absolute; right: 0; top: 0; bottom: 0; width: 55%; background: linear-gradient(to right, var(--navy) 0%, transparent 100%); }
    .page-hero-inner { max-width: 1440px; margin: 0 auto; position: relative; z-index: 2; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; gap: 48px; align-items: end; }
    .page-hero-eyebrow { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 2px; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--accent); margin-bottom: 20px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; }
    .page-hero-eyebrow::before { content: ''; width: 28px; height: 2px; background: var(--accent); }
    .page-hero-title { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: clamp(34px, 4.5vw, 56px); font-weight: 700; color: #fff; line-height: 1.1; max-width: 640px; margin-bottom: 20px; }
    .page-hero-sub { font-size: 16px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.65); max-width: 520px; line-height: 1.7; margin-bottom: 32px; }
    .btn-gold { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 13px 28px; font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 700; background: var(--accent); color: var(--navy); border-radius: 4px; transition: all 0.2s; letter-spacing: 0.3px; }
    .btn-gold:hover { background: var(--accent-hover); transform: translateY(-2px); }
    .btn-gold::after { content: '→'; }
    .hero-feature-box { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12); border-radius: 12px; padding: 28px 32px; text-align: center; backdrop-filter: blur(8px); min-width: 180px; }
    .hero-feature-num { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 42px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--accent); line-height: 1; }
    .hero-feature-label { font-size: 12px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.6); margin-top: 6px; letter-spacing: 0.3px; }

    /* INTRO */
    .intro-section { padding: 72px 40px; max-width: 1440px; margin: 0 auto; }
    .section-label { font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 2px; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--primary); margin-bottom: 12px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; }
    .section-label::after { content: ''; width: 40px; height: 2px; background: var(--primary); }
    .section-title { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: clamp(28px, 3.5vw, 44px); font-weight: 700; color: var(--text-primary); line-height: 1.15; }
    .section-subtitle { font-size: 16px; color: var(--text-secondary); max-width: 560px; line-height: 1.7; margin-top: 12px; }
    .intro-2col { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 64px; align-items: start; }
    .intro-body { font-size: 16px; color: var(--text-secondary); line-height: 1.8; }

    /* CAPABILITIES GRID */
    .capabilities-section { background: var(--gray-100); padding: 80px 0; }
    .capabilities-inner { max-width: 1440px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 40px; }
    .capabilities-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 24px; margin-top: 48px; }
    .cap-card { background: #fff; border-radius: 10px; padding: 32px 28px; border: 1px solid var(--border); transition: transform 0.25s, box-shadow 0.25s, border-color 0.25s; }
    .cap-card:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); box-shadow: 0 16px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.08); border-color: var(--primary); }
    .cap-card-icon { width: 48px; height: 48px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary), var(--primary-dark)); border-radius: 10px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; margin-bottom: 20px; color: var(--accent); }
    .cap-card-title { font-size: 17px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--text-primary); margin-bottom: 12px; }
    .cap-card-body { font-size: 14px; color: var(--text-secondary); line-height: 1.75; }

    /* FEATURED PARTNERS CAROUSEL */
    .carousel-section { padding: 80px 0; background: var(--navy); }
    .carousel-inner { max-width: 1440px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 40px; }
    .carousel-label { font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 2px; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--accent); margin-bottom: 12px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; }
    .carousel-label::after { content: ''; width: 40px; height: 2px; background: var(--accent); }
    .carousel-title { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: clamp(28px, 3vw, 38px); font-weight: 700; color: #fff; margin-bottom: 40px; }
    .carousel-track { position: relative; }
    .carousel-slide { display: none; }
    .carousel-slide.active { display: block; animation: fadeIn 0.4s ease; }
    @keyframes fadeIn { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateX(16px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(0); } }
    .carousel-card { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12); border-radius: 12px; padding: 40px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; gap: 40px; align-items: start; }
    .carousel-card-title { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 26px; font-weight: 700; color: #fff; margin-bottom: 16px; }
    .carousel-card-body { font-size: 15px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.65); line-height: 1.8; }
    .carousel-card-stat { text-align: center; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); border-radius: 10px; padding: 28px 32px; flex-shrink: 0; }
    .carousel-stat-num { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 44px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--accent); }
    .carousel-stat-label { font-size: 12px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.55); margin-top: 6px; }
    .carousel-controls { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; margin-top: 28px; }
    .carousel-btn { width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 50%; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2); color: #fff; cursor: pointer; font-size: 18px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; transition: background 0.2s; }
    .carousel-btn:hover { background: var(--accent); border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--navy); }
    .carousel-dots { display: flex; gap: 8px; }
    .carousel-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.25); cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s; border: none; }
    .carousel-dot.active { background: var(--accent); }

    /* DEAL FLOW CTA */
    .deal-cta-section { padding: 80px 40px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary) 0%, var(--primary-dark) 100%); }
    .deal-cta-inner { max-width: 1440px; margin: 0 auto; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 48px; }
    .deal-cta-text { }
    .deal-cta-title { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 38px; font-weight: 700; color: #fff; margin-bottom: 14px; }
    .deal-cta-sub { font-size: 16px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7); max-width: 440px; }
    .btn-outline-white { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 13px 28px; font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 700; border: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.6); color: #fff; border-radius: 4px; transition: all 0.2s; white-space: nowrap; }
    .btn-outline-white:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.12); border-color: #fff; }
    .btn-outline-white::after { content: '→'; }

    /* TESTIMONIAL */
    .testimonial-section { padding: 80px 40px; }
    .testimonial-inner { max-width: 900px; margin: 0 auto; text-align: center; }
    .testimonial-quote { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: clamp(22px, 3vw, 32px); font-weight: 600; color: var(--text-primary); line-height: 1.4; margin-bottom: 32px; position: relative; }
    .testimonial-quote::before { content: '\201C'; font-size: 80px; color: var(--accent); opacity: 0.3; position: absolute; top: -24px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); font-family: var(--font-display); line-height: 1; }
    .testimonial-author { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text-primary); }
    .testimonial-role { font-size: 13px; color: var(--text-muted); margin-top: 4px; }

    /* FEATURED TOPICS */
    .topics-section { background: var(--gray-100); padding: 72px 0; }
    .topics-inner { max-width: 1440px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 40px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 80px; align-items: start; }
    .topics-list { margin-top: 32px; }
    .topic-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; padding: 18px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); transition: padding-left 0.2s; cursor: pointer; }
    .topic-item:hover { padding-left: 8px; }
    .topic-item:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
    .topic-num { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--accent); width: 28px; flex-shrink: 0; }
    .topic-name { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text-primary); flex: 1; }
    .topic-arrow { font-size: 14px; color: var(--primary); }
    .topics-visual { height: 360px; border-radius: 12px; overflow: hidden; background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary) 0%, var(--primary-dark) 100%); position: relative; }
    .topics-visual img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; opacity: 0.75; }
    .topics-visual-overlay { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: linear-gradient(to top, rgba(0,0,0,0.6) 0%, transparent 50%); }
    .topics-visual-caption { position: absolute; bottom: 24px; left: 24px; right: 24px; color: #fff; }
    .topics-visual-caption h3 { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 6px; }
    .topics-visual-caption p { font-size: 13px; opacity: 0.75; }

    /* PROPERTY TYPES CTA */
    .property-types-section { padding: 72px 40px; }
    .property-types-inner { max-width: 1440px; margin: 0 auto; }
    .property-types-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr); gap: 16px; margin-top: 40px; }
    .property-type-card { border-radius: 8px; overflow: hidden; height: 200px; position: relative; cursor: pointer; }
    .property-type-card img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; transition: transform 0.4s; }
    .property-type-card:hover img { transform: scale(1.05); }
    .property-type-overlay { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: linear-gradient(to top, rgba(0,0,0,0.75) 0%, rgba(0,0,0,0.2) 100%); display: flex; align-items: flex-end; padding: 16px; }
    .property-type-label { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; color: #fff; }

    /* RELATED SERVICES */
    .related-section { background: var(--gray-100); padding: 72px 0; }
    .related-inner { max-width: 1440px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 40px; }
    .related-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); gap: 24px; margin-top: 40px; }
    .related-card { background: #fff; border-radius: 10px; padding: 32px; border: 1px solid var(--border); display: flex; gap: 20px; transition: border-color 0.2s, transform 0.2s; }
    .related-card:hover { border-color: var(--primary); transform: translateY(-2px); }
    .related-card-icon { width: 44px; height: 44px; background: var(--gray-100); border-radius: 8px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; color: var(--primary); flex-shrink: 0; }
    .related-card-body { }
    .related-card-title { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--text-primary); margin-bottom: 8px; }
    .related-card-text { font-size: 13px; color: var(--text-secondary); line-height: 1.6; margin-bottom: 16px; }
    .related-link { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--primary); display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; }
    .related-link::after { content: '→'; }

    /* RELATED INSIGHTS */
    .related-insights-section { padding: 72px 0; }
    .related-insights-inner { max-width: 1440px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 40px; }
    .insights-grid-3 { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 28px; margin-top: 40px; }
    .insight-mini { border-bottom: 3px solid transparent; padding-bottom: 24px; transition: border-color 0.2s; }
    .insight-mini:hover { border-bottom-color: var(--primary); }
    .insight-mini-img { height: 180px; border-radius: 8px; overflow: hidden; background: var(--gray-100); margin-bottom: 16px; }
    .insight-mini-img img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; }
    .insight-mini-tag { font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 1.5px; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--primary); margin-bottom: 8px; }
    .insight-mini-title { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text-primary); line-height: 1.4; }

    /* FOOTER */
    .site-footer { background: var(--navy); padding: 64px 40px 32px; }
    .footer-inner { max-width: 1440px; margin: 0 auto; }
    .footer-top { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 260px 1fr; gap: 80px; padding-bottom: 48px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); }
    .footer-logo { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; color: #fff; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; margin-bottom: 16px; }
    .footer-tagline { font-size: 13px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5); line-height: 1.7; }
    .footer-nav-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); gap: 32px; }
    .footer-nav-title { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 1.5px; text-transform: uppercase; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.4); margin-bottom: 16px; }
    .footer-nav-link { display: block; font-size: 13.5px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.65); padding: 5px 0; transition: color 0.15s; }
    .footer-nav-link:hover { color: #fff; }
    .footer-bottom { padding-top: 28px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 16px; }
    .footer-copy { font-size: 12px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.35); }
    .footer-legal { display: flex; gap: 24px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
    .footer-legal a { font-size: 12px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.45); }
    .footer-legal a:hover { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.8); }

    @media (max-width: 1200px) {
      .header-inner { padding: 0 24px; }
      .main-nav { display: none; }
      .mobile-toggle { display: flex; }
      .mobile-drawer { display: block; }
      .capabilities-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
      .property-types-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); }
    }
    @media (max-width: 900px) {
      .page-hero-inner { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .hero-feature-box { display: none; }
      .intro-2col { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 36px; }
      .carousel-card { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .deal-cta-inner { flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; }
      .topics-inner { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .topics-visual { height: 280px; }
      .related-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .insights-grid-3 { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .footer-top { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 40px; }
      .footer-nav-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }
    }
    @media (max-width: 600px) {
      .page-hero { padding: 32px 20px 56px; }
      .breadcrumb { padding: 78px 20px 16px; }
      .intro-section, .deal-cta-section, .testimonial-section, .property-types-section { padding-left: 20px; padding-right: 20px; }
      .capabilities-inner, .carousel-inner, .topics-inner, .related-inner, .related-insights-inner { padding: 0 20px; }
      .capabilities-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .property-types-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }
      .site-footer { padding: 48px 20px 24px; }
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>

<!-- HEADER -->
<header class="site-header">
  <div class="header-inner">
    <a href="index.html" class="logo"><div class="logo-mark"></div>GlobalStone</a>
    <nav class="main-nav">
      <div class="nav-item" id="services-nav-item">
        <span class="nav-link has-dropdown" tabindex="0" role="button">Services</span>
        <div class="mega-menu">
          <div class="mega-menu-grid">
            <div>
              <div class="mega-col-title">By Need</div>
              <a class="mega-link" href="services-invest-finance-value.html" style="color:var(--primary);font-weight:700;">Invest, Finance & Value</a>
              <a class="mega-link" href="services-plan-lease-occupy.html">Plan, Lease & Occupy</a>
              <a class="mega-link" href="services-design-build.html">Design & Build</a>
              <a class="mega-link" href="services.html">Manage Properties & Portfolios</a>
              <a class="mega-link" href="services.html">Transform Business Outcomes</a>

steps.message:
All 5 pages are built and verified. Here's a summary of what was delivered:

---

**GlobalStone — 5-Page Corporate Website** — complete at `/app/output/`

**Design Direction:** Luxury/Refined — deep navy (`#0A1628`) + forest green (`#003F2D`) + gold accent (`#C9A84C`). Playfair Display headlines paired with Plus Jakarta Sans body text for editorial gravitas.

**Pages delivered:**

| File | Page | Key Features |
|------|------|------|
| `index.html` | Homepage | Hero + stats, featured insights, announcement banner, about statement, **What We Do vertical tabs**, newsletter, latest insights, commitment pillars |
| `services.html` | Services Overview | 6-card service grid with icons, intro stats, intro statement |
| `services-invest-finance-value.html` | Invest / Finance / Value | 6-capability grid, **3-slide partner carousel**, deal-flow CTA, testimonial, featured topics, property types, related services |
| `services-plan-lease-occupy.html` | Plan / Lease / Occupy | 6-capability grid, "Why GlobalStone" dark section with feature list, related insights |
| `services-design-build.html` | Design & Build | 2 large capability cards with images, 5-step delivery process, partnership metrics, gold CTA banner |

**All interactions implemented:**
- **Mega menu** (hover + click, aria-compliant) with By Need / By Property Type columns
- **Mobile accordion drawer** — expands/collapses service sub-links
- **What We Do vertical tabs** — animated panel switching with `role="tabpanel"`
- **Partner carousel** — prev/next + dot navigation
- **Newsletter subscribe** — with confirmation state
- **Scroll-reveal animations** on all cards
